headlines.title: 中国30年期国债期货创近8个月新高，债市或告别“三低”震荡
headlines.summary: 近日，债市终于摆脱持续的“三低”状态——低成交、低波动、低股债相关性，走出新方向：超长端债券明显走强，7月27日，30年期国债期货主力合约盘中一度升至115.18元，创近8个月新高。多家机构认为，本轮超长债突破，既缘于前期低波动行情积蓄了较强动能，又与基本面偏弱、再通胀预期反复落空、央行呵护资金面，以及机构对超长端期限利差压缩的重新定价有关。不过，在基金久期偏高、政府债供给压力尚未完全落地的背景下，后续行情能否延续，仍取决于配置盘能否接力交易盘。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: China's 30-year government bond futures hit an 8-month high; bond market may exit 'three low' volatility.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the bond market has finally broken free from the persistent 'three lows' state—low trading volume, low volatility, low stock-bond correlation—heading in a new direction: ultra-long-term bonds have notably strengthened. On July 27, the 30-year government bond futures main contract briefly rose to 115.18 yuan during trading, hitting an 8-month high. Multiple institutions believe this breakout is driven by strong momentum accumulated from prior low volatility, weak fundamentals, repeated disappointments in reflation expectations, PBOC's liquidity support, and institutional repricing of the ultra-long-end term spread compression. However, with fund duration at high levels and government bond supply pressure not fully materialized, whether the trend can continue depends on allocation desks taking over from trading desks. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 31省份上半年GDP出炉：15省份增速跑赢全国，经济大省“挑大梁”作用凸显
headlines.summary: 当前，全国31个省份的经济“半年报”已全部揭晓，其中15个省份的GDP增速跑赢全国平均水平（4.7%）。从经济增速看，西藏GDP增速达6.3%，领跑全国；紧随其后的浙江为5.7%。此外，增速在5.5%以上的省份还有山东、上海、安徽。从经济总量看，前十席位依次为广东、江苏、山东、浙江、四川、河南、湖北、福建、上海、安徽。上述经济十强省份体量合计占全国比重超六成，“挑大梁”作用凸显。其中，广东、江苏上半年突破7万亿元，山东上半年突破5万亿元，安徽重返全国前十。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: 31 provinces' H1 GDP released: 15 provinces grow faster than national average, major economic provinces play key role.
headlines.summary_en: Currently, the economic 'mid-year reports' for all 31 provinces have been released, with 15 provinces' GDP growth exceeding the national average (4.7%). In terms of growth rate, Tibet leads at 6.3%, followed by Zhejiang at 5.7%. Provinces with growth above 5.5% include Shandong, Shanghai, and Anhui. For total economic output, the top ten rankings are: Guangdong, Jiangsu, Shandong, Zhejiang, Sichuan, Henan, Hubei, Fujian, Shanghai, and Anhui. These top ten economies together account for over 60% of the national total, highlighting their key supporting role. Guangdong and Jiangsu exceeded 7 trillion yuan in H1, Shandong surpassed 5 trillion yuan, and Anhui returned to the top ten nationally. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title_en: Guotai & Haitan: Risk assets maintain high cost-effectiveness, recommend overweight A-shares, H-shares, and US stocks.
headlines.summary_en: Guotai Junan Hai Tong released a research report stating that geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are fluctuating and uncertain, but the overall trend still points to a declining tail-risk scenario. The current market may still be affected by corporate earnings verification, AI industry returns, and geopolitical factors, with short-term volatility not fully subsiding, but sensitivity to negative news is expected to marginally decline. The firm recommends overweighting A-shares, H-shares, and US stocks.

headlines.title: 多家上市银行年中工作会议定调：持续加强资产负债管理，向数智化转型要成效
headlines.summary: 在多重考验交织下，银行业走完2026年上半程。随着年中工作会议的陆续召开，多家上市银行下半年的经营路线图也正式浮出水面。透过一系列会议可见：多家银行明确将加强资产负债管理、提升多元收益作为破局关键；与此同时，持续提升服务实体经济质效、加快数智化转型、强化风险防控等也是各家银行下半年的重点任务。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple listed banks set tone at mid-year meetings: Strengthen asset-liability management, push for digital transformation results.
headlines.summary_en: Under multiple challenges, the banking sector has completed 2026 H1. With mid-year meetings underway, the operational roadmaps for H2 of several listed banks have emerged. Key themes include enhancing asset-liability management and diversifying revenue sources; meanwhile, improving real economy service quality, accelerating digital transformation, and strengthening risk control remain priorities. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 多家公司同日停牌谋易主 A股“卖壳”潮涌动
headlines.summary: A股市场7月27日出现一幕扎堆景象——普联软件、欣天科技、佳云科技、贝肯能源、联创电子等上市公司同时处于停牌状态，且均因筹划控制权变更事宜。从各家披露的公告来看，这些公司的实控人正急于让渡手中股权，有的甚至计划清仓退出。多家上市公司集中筹划控制权变更，当前资本市场“壳交易”正升温。

headlines.title_en: Multiple companies halt trading for ownership change; A-share 'shell selling' wave emerges.
headlines.summary_en: On July 27, A-share markets saw a cluster of suspensions—Pulian Software, Xintian Technology, Jiayun Technology, Beiken Energy, Lianchuang Electronics, among others, were simultaneously halted, all due to planned changes in control rights. According to their disclosures, these companies' actual controllers are urgently transferring their equity stakes, some even planning full exits. The concentration of multiple listed companies planning control changes suggests a warming 'shell transaction' market.

headlines.title: 波动中调仓换股，海外基金经理上演多空“攻防战”
headlines.summary: 近期，面对全球科技股尤其是半导体板块的剧烈波动，海外基金经理正积极调仓：一方面，多家机构因半导体板块估值高企而减少相关持仓，甚至追加空头头寸；另一方面，资金并未真正离场，而是流入软件、金融、医疗、工业、公用事业等低估值板块，部分投资者更是将目光投向太空经济等前沿领域。尽管对短期板块走势的判断存在较大分歧，但多家机构认为，全球人工智能的长期投资逻辑并未动摇，此轮调整更多是拥挤交易后的估值修复与情绪出清，为新一轮布局打开了窗口。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Portfolio rebalancing amid volatility: Overseas fund managers engage in long-short 'battle'.
headlines.summary_en: Recently, amid sharp global tech stock volatility, especially in semiconductors, overseas fund managers are actively rebalancing: on one hand, several institutions reduce semiconductor holdings due to high valuations, even adding short positions; on the other hand, funds are not leaving but flowing into undervalued sectors like software, financials, healthcare, industrials, and utilities, while some investors turn to frontier fields like the space economy. Despite significant disagreement on short-term sector direction, many institutions believe the long-term AI investment thesis remains intact, with the current adjustment more about valuation repair and sentiment cleansing after crowded trades, opening a window for new positioning. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 突破4000美元“拉锯区”，金价筑底信号显现
headlines.summary: 自6月以来，黄金持续磨底，近期在4000美元/盎司附近拉锯后迎来突破。受访专家认为，短期内美伊局势仍是金价的核心主线，当前正处于黄金筑底阶段，市场对利多信号变得敏感。同时，“加息交易”动能趋于极限，油价已从压制性变量变为多重变量之一。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Breaking through $4000 'consolidation zone'; gold price bottoming signals emerge.
headlines.summary_en: Since June, gold has been grinding a bottom, breaking out after recent consolidation around $4,000/oz. Experts interviewed say short-term US-Iran tensions remain the core driver for gold, now in a bottoming phase with markets becoming sensitive to positive signals. Meanwhile, 'rate hike trade' momentum is nearing its limit, and oil has shifted from a suppressing variable to one of multiple factors. (Shanghai Securities News)
